Subject: Your breach of contract matter - CS(COMM) 2719/2020

Dear Mr. Joshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 19 January 2021 about your dispute with Shinde Infotech Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the claim must be filed as a commercial suit.

Our advice is to complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit. Please collect the mediation request and the statement of accounts and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
